purpose: Preparation contract for a read-only model_1998.pt Source Terrain qualification scan; no PPO update or checkpoint selection.

research_boundary.observation_contract: 45D proprioceptive policy observation; no height scan or privileged terrain observation
research_boundary.action_contract: existing 12D joint action and deployment-matched action scaling; no online adapter/residual update

terrain_families.name: flat
terrain_families.source_boundary: nominal plane; level differences are reset or qualification labels, not different geometry

terrain_families.name: multi_scale_rough
terrain_families.source_boundary: correlated continuous multi-band height field; not discrete rocky blocks

terrain_families.name: multi_step_stairs
terrain_families.source_boundary: straight continuous ascending/descending stairs; stairs remain a Source family

terrain_families.name: slope_plus_rough
terrain_families.source_boundary: audited continuous slope plus bounded multi-scale roughness

terrain_families.name: friction_variation
terrain_families.source_boundary: four spatial material regions; separate from whole-episode friction randomization

difficulty_levels.interpretation: all numeric values are explicit scan candidates, not approved Source training limits

flat.L2: same plane with the same deterministic reset profile
flat.L3: same plane; no unqualified dynamics perturbation

fixed_before_first_run: terrain generator code and geometry audit version
reset pose, command, safety configuration, termination contract, and track endpoint

completion_and_termination.complete: robot reaches the registered full-track endpoint, has no safety violation, and remains stable for the registered completion hold; partial progress is insufficient
completion_and_termination.fall: environment fall/orientation termination or registered unsafe body state
completion_and_termination.body_contact: any non-foot contact is recorded separately and termination follows the registered contact rule
completion_and_termination.lateral_out_of_bounds: root lateral position exceeds the audited lane boundary minus the registered margin
completion_and_termination.safety_termination: SafetyFilter emergency stop, safety guard termination, or invalid/non-finite action/state
completion_and_termination.timeout: 2000 control steps without completion; report as truncated, never as success
completion_and_termination.threshold_status: runtime thresholds are copied into the independent termination contract; bridge qualification is still outstanding

seed_plan.allocation: Each cell pairs five distinct geometry seed IDs with five distinct initial_state seed IDs; the current reset is deterministic, so initial_state seeds are bookkeeping keys, not a claim of randomized initial states.
seed_plan.reuse_policy: scan seeds cannot be reused for source train/validation, development headroom, independent probes, C1 online curves, or sealed evaluation
seed_plan.seed_semantics: Flat and fixed-parameter regular slope/stairs cells intentionally repeat geometry across distinct seeds; seeds identify independent reset/episode trials, not fabricated geometry variation. Rough, slope-plus-rough, and friction cells retain generator variation.

data_isolation_and_execution_guards.output_directory_policy: new non-overwriting run directory; metrics only; no policy checkpoint

scan_runner.reason: No manifest-driven Isaac Sim episode runner with complete metrics and safety bridge exists yet.

user_approval_record.reason: Execution approval must be a separate later user action after all runtime qualifications.

sample_count_and_uncertainty.interval_method: Wilson score interval for binary completion outcomes; bootstrap percentile summaries only for variable-geometry conditions; fixed-geometry repeats are reported as repeated trials without instance-generalization claims

current_implementation_blockers.finding: SafetyFilter has unit-level implementation, but end-to-end frozen policy action wiring, shadow evaluation, and episode safety traces have not passed qualification.
No manifest-driven Isaac Sim runner currently enforces the v0.2 cells, seed pairing, complete metrics, and non-overwriting output policy.
Complete reset-to-completion episode collection for all 45 cells is not yet available; the existing smoke only steps once.
Straight-stair tread candidates are explicit and generated, but Lite3 stance, foot clearance, and stride calibration remains a qualification task.
Numeric classification values remain a proposal and must be reviewed before any execution lock.

preparation_notes: This preparation manifest is intentionally draft_not_for_run and execution_authorized=false.
The Isaac bridge smoke verified geometry loading, height-scan mesh coverage, and friction-region material binding; it did not load model_1998.pt or run a policy episode.
No PPO update, source training, development selection, or sealed access is authorized by this file.
For fixed-parameter Flat, regular Slope, and regular Stairs, seed IDs do not create new geometry; their episodes are repeated trials, not independent terrain instances.
